summary: Coincheck Group issued a Form 6-K announcing the completion of KDDI Corporation's strategic investment. KDDI purchased 28,536,516 newly issued shares at $2.28 per share for $65 million aggregate cash, representing 14.9% ownership. The investment closed pursuant to a May 12, 2026 Subscription Agreement. KDDI receives registration rights and the right to nominate one non-executive director at the September 2026 AGM. Concurrently, Coincheck's Japanese subsidiary entered a business alliance with KDDI for digital asset market expansion in Japan. The filing is a completion announcement of a previously disclosed private investment in public equity (PIPE). Watch for operational synergies and board changes.
